assumptions: Country is selected by operator, but historical salaries/costs are only assumed applicable to those countries. No numeric country cost factor or WTP adjustment is invented.
Effective dates declare simulation evaluation window only, not verified provider or payroll validity. All sources estimated; dataMode historical.
Writer and SEO reserve their full monthly hiring cost once; consumed hours must not make these salaries disappear.
Designer retains expediente allocation 30% scaled by activated module workload (120/152), not half-time from the previous pilot.
Remaining seed profiles use 180h denominator and 1.25 cost sensitivity from source; these are neither productive-hours capacity nor commercial quote rates.
Fees are split from human costs. Explicit shares reproduce the historical hourly allocation solely for reconciliation; they do not approve a fee policy for fractional resources.
Delivery reserve 15% is a cost provision, not Talent Assurance certification/training priced or guaranteed.
Other provision contains unspecified tools/overhead; no extra tools, 25 USD Assurance/management placeholders or synthetic onboarding are added to duplicate it.
Annual-average FTE does not validate peaks, headcount, availability or monthly schedule.
Kernel staffing DTO is used only as a capacity economics probe; managed service scope, activated projects and billing milestones are not implemented by this fixture.
No taxes, salary indexes, WTP, treasury costs or complete guarantees are inferred.
BASE work hours include all SEO/writer tasks from the source capacity plan; actual gradual task volume/calendar must be reconciled separately.

cases.meaning: Cost-only internal reconciliation; net equals modeled cost, not selling price.
Sensitivity with historical aspirational margin 40%; not approved new price.
